lines.evidence: tools/ticket-manifest.mjs:167-174 adds listed test files to build outputs and records ownedTestFiles; test 'a build ticket owns and is prompted to write the tests it lists' in tests/ticket-manifest-owns.test.mjs:14-19 asserts both output ownership and prompt wording.

tools/ticket-manifest.mjs:35-50 defines criticalPathLength; test 'build-owned tests shorten the critical path compared with a separate test ticket per build' in tests/ticket-manifest-owns.test.mjs:31-45 asserts 2 tickets versus 4.

tools/wiring.mjs:124-138 removes a build ticket's dependency on the separate test ticket when the build lists the test file, then makes the test wait for the build; test 'a build ticket that owns its test does not wait on the separate test ticket' in tests/wiring-build-owns.test.mjs:16-28 asserts both dependency changes.

tools/wiring.mjs:128-133 records flipped ownership and :143 emits the 'owns its tests' note; the same test in tests/wiring-build-owns.test.mjs:16-28 asserts that note, while the unordered case at :31-40 verifies the ordering note.

tools/scope-commands.mjs:1078-1082 runs ingest acceptance checks, :1091-1093 applies test ordering, and tests/scope-ingest-owns-tests.test.mjs:82-95 runs scope split --ingest with a build-owned test and no separate test ticket, asserting exit 0 and no acceptance refusal.

tools/scope-commands.mjs:1127-1129 reports the actual critical path and test-first comparison; test 'ingest accepts a build-owned test as acceptance proof and reports the shorter path' in tests/scope-ingest-owns-tests.test.mjs:82-95 asserts 'critical path: 2 tickets' and 'test-first would be 4'.
